title.en: Poem Written in a Boat on the Wu River

credit_line.en: Gift of John M. Crawford Jr., in honor of Professor Wen Fong, 1984

intro.zh: 米芾（1051–1107）被大都会博物馆称为北宋后期最重要的书法家，也是公认的宋代四大书法家之一。
intro.en: Mi Fu (1051–1107) is called by the Met the leading calligrapher of the late Northern Song, and is counted among the four major calligraphers of the Song.

intro.zh: 诗写吴江上的一条船：风向转东，船陷在泥里不动，加了钱之后纤夫才一下把它拉走。
intro.en: The poem tells of a boat on the Wu River: the wind turns east, the boat sticks fast in the mud, and only when the trackers are paid more do they haul it free in a single pull.

intro.zh: 他悬臂、用肘运笔，不求每个字完美，而是任由笔势让字倾倒、变形，以求表现力。
intro.en: He wrote with a suspended arm, working from the elbow; rather than perfect characters, he let the force of the brush collapse and distort them for the sake of expressiveness.

look_for.zh: 从上往下、从右往左读，共44行，行书和草书兼用。
look_for.en: Read top to bottom and right to left: 44 columns in semi-cursive and cursive script.

look_for.zh: 这一段是诗的开头：“昨风起西北，万艘皆乘便”。
look_for.en: This section is the opening of the poem: 昨風起西北，萬艘皆乘便 ('Yesterday's wind arose from the north-west, and innumerable boats all took advantage of it').

look_for.zh: 字向不同方向倾斜，大小突然变化。
look_for.en: Characters that tilt in different directions and suddenly change size.

alt.zh: 手卷中的一段：浅色纸上大而倾斜的黑色行书，有红色印章，右边是一块写满小字的题跋。
alt.en: A section of a handscroll: large, slanting black characters in running script on light paper, with red seals and a panel of small writing at the right.

views.zh: 据大都会博物馆的英译，他把米芾的字比作疾风中的帆船、冲入战阵的战马。
views.en: In the Met's translation, he likened Mi's writing to a sailboat in a gust of wind, or a warhorse charging into battle.

quote.en: a sailboat in a gust of wind, or a warhorse charging into battle

views.zh: 他认为书法能显露书写者的性情；大都会博物馆说，很少有作品像这卷一样清楚地印证这一点。
views.en: He held that calligraphy reveals the writer's character and emotions; the Met says few works show this as clearly as this scroll.

note.zh: 每一句都对照所注出处核对过；找不到可靠出处的说法已删去或改写。
note.en: Every sentence was checked against the sources it cites; claims without a reliable source were cut or rewritten.
